KNOW #8 📚 Bid Vs Ask
Chart pe jo price dikh rahi hai, aap usi pe buy karte ho? Nahi.
• Ask wo rate hai jis pe aap buy karte ho, thoda upar.
• Bid wo rate hai jis pe aap sell karte ho, thoda neeche.
• Chart zyaadatar bid dikhata hai. Isliye sell trade ka SL spread ki wajah se jaldi hit ho sakta hai.
Tip: stop loss me spread ka buffer jodo.

Drawdown kya hai? 📉

Account ki sabse unchi jagah peak hai. Peak se jitna gira, wahi drawdown. 1.2 lakh se 90 hazaar = 25% drawdown. Sabse badi giraawat ko max drawdown kehte hain. Profit batata hai kya mil sakta hai, drawdown batata hai raaste me kya sehna padega.

40% win rate pe bhi profit kaise?

Tip: entry se pehle target aur stop dono likho.

Har trade me kitna lot lagaun? ⚖️

Pehle tay karo kitna risk lena hai, phir SL ki doori dekho. Size = account × risk % ÷ (SL doori × 1 point ki keemat). SL chauda hai to lot chhota, SL chhota hai to lot bada. Risk wahi rehta hai.
